list.name: 会议记录分析员（共享版）

entries.name: Canvas
entries.description: Experimental Canvas control and A2UI rendering surfaces for paired nodes.

entries.name: Codex Supervisor
entries.description: Supervise Codex app-server sessions from OpenClaw.

entries.name: File Transfer
entries.description: Fetch, list, and write files on paired nodes via dedicated node commands. Bypasses bash stdout truncation by using base64 over node.invoke for binaries up to 16 MB.

entries.name: LLM Task
entries.description: Generic JSON-only LLM tool for structured tasks callable from workflows.

entries.name: Memory (Core)
entries.description: File-backed memory search tools and CLI

entries.name: Memory Wiki
entries.description: Persistent wiki compiler and Obsidian-friendly knowledge vault for OpenClaw.

entries.name: Feishu
entries.description: Lark/Feishu channel plugin with im/doc/wiki/drive/task/calendar tools

entries.name: Workboard
entries.description: Dashboard workboard for agent-owned issues and sessions.

entries.name: brand-poster-creator
entries.description: 品牌海报全流程生成技能（含项目分级与审批流）。从需求收集、版式锁定、文案策划、生图到交付清理的全链路协调器，支持 B/A/S 三级项目管理、自动审批提醒、时间记录与复盘分析。触发词：品牌海报、海报生成、做张海报、节日海报、产品海报、春节海报、营销海报

entries.name: brand-poster-distiller
entries.description: 用于把参考海报蒸馏为可复用的版式结构（骨架图+坐标表），并配套本地蒸馏库网页进行查看、搜索、筛选、编辑与按 ID 调用。

entries.name: dreamina-cli
entries.description: 即梦视频生成底层 CLI 封装。仅用于视频生成任务，不得用于图片生成。应由其他 skill（如 dreamina-reference-video）调用，不应被用户直接触发。

entries.name: dreamina-reference-video
entries.description: Use when the user wants to reduce 视频抽卡, keep 角色一致性, build 角色板或身份板与故事板, use 即梦 CLI 或 dreamina 或 Seedance 或 全能参考, or turn one idea into a staged 多参考图视频流程 before正式生成视频.

entries.name: image-deglaze
entries.description: 基于参考图的高清重绘工具：用 AI 理解原图构图、风格、元素后，以更高质量重新生成。适合”基于草图生成高清成品”、”风格化高清重绘”、”低质量图片高清化（允许内容优化）”等场景。触发词：”参考图重绘”、”草图转高清”、”风格化重绘”、”提升画质（允许优化）”。不适合”完全保持原图内容去包浆”（那种需求请推荐 Real-ESRGAN、Magnific AI 等超分辨率工具）。调用 gpt-image2-gen 做整图重生。

entries.name: omni-vision-psd-extractor
entries.description: 【全息万物提取PSD构建器】智能版：仅 2 次 API 请求 + 自动 4K 缩放 + 前景自动切割 + 三层 PSD 结构 + 飞书云盘直接交付

entries.name: product-photography-workflow
entries.description: Use when users ask for product photography, product still-life images, white-background product shots, clean tabletop product visuals, or product-image generation based on real product photos and style references, especially when the same product may need multiple continued tasks over time.

entries.name: RunningHub
entries.description: Use when the user mentions runninghub / RunningHub / RunningHub API, asks for RunningHub AI Applications or custom ComfyUI workflows by webappId, or uses Feishu shortcut trigger words: 创作中心, 视频魔法, 检查余额. Generate images, videos, audio, and 3D models via RunningHub API (294 endpoints). Do not use only when the user explicitly asks for a specific custom image_generate model/provider by name, such as WB万能图片 2.0.

entries.name: video-expert-analyzer
entries.description: Advanced video analysis and selection skill with AI-powered automatic scoring. Integrates Walter Murch's rules and dynamic weighting for professional-grade curation. Supports Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin (抖音), and Xiaohongshu (小红书). Use this skill whenever the user wants to analyze videos, score or rate scenes, extract best shots/highlights, evaluate video quality, curate clips, do competitor video analysis, or mentions terms like "视频分析", "镜头筛选", "场景评分", "视频拆解", "精选片段", "视频质量", "镜头打分", "素材挑选" — even if they don't explicitly ask for "expert analysis".

entries.name: xiangqingye-desigen
entries.description: 从 0 开始规划电商详情页工作流：3 阶段紧凑流程（策略 → 手稿 → 成稿），默认单张方形画板 1920x1920 4 列纵向排列全部屏，全局风格指南确保风格统一，项目化文件管理避免混乱。适用于详情页策划、详情页手稿、电商长图、移动端详情页、PC详情页、详情页生成与拼接。重点服务食品/烘焙/快消品，也可泛化到其他消费品。触发词包括：详情页、详情页手稿、电商长图、移动端详情页、PC详情页、详情页策划、详情页生成、详情页拼接。
